responsibility: This generated option-table file lists the accepted enumerated values for m68k target options. It defines GCC Enum/EnumValue tables for target_device (-mcpu=), uarch_type (-mtune=), and m68k_isa (-march=), derived from the corresponding *.def lists, so the driver and option parser can validate and translate user-supplied CPU, tuning, and ISA names into backend enum values. Unlike m68k.opt, it supplies generated enumerator contents rather than hand-written option declarations.
